Hi. :>

> something happened in our game tonight :
> a baali played a condemnation : X was blocked. He played majesty,
> untapped, and then attempted to play condemnation : Y.
> He did so despite of my whining.... but i still think
> Condemnation : X and Condemnation : Y is the same type of action
> for NRA purpose. The evidence ?

None.
Actions are defined by type, and by name. There is no action type
called "Condemnation". There is no tournament rules based prohibition
on playing multiple different action cards that have Condemnation in
their name as long as the rest of the title is different.

> when you play a condemnation on a minion, card text says
> "burn all other condemnation on this minion". So all condemnation
> are a single type of card.

Right, they are all action cards. :>

> The same way zahir can fetch in your library a contract /
> clandestine contract / dirty contract. Contract is a contract,
> condemnation is a condemnation. so NRA triggers.

No, pursuing a Contract is not pursuing a Contract is not
pursuing a Contract. A minion may enter combat thru one
type of contract, untap, then enter combat thru another type
of contract. This does not violate NRA in any way.

> what do you think LSJ ?

Messages.Author: Frederick Scott
Messages.Body:
Reyda wrote:
> something happened in our game tonight :
> a baali played a condemnation : X was blocked. He played majesty, untapped,
> and then attempted to play condemnation : Y.
> He did so despite of my whining.... but i still think Condemnation : X and
> Condemnation : Y is the same type of action for NRA purpose. The evidence ?
> when you play a condemnation on a minion, card text says "burn all other
> condemnation on this minion". So all condemnation are a single type of card.

Sorry, no. The "types" of cards are limited to a specific listed in the
rulebook and relisted in the tournament rules. They are (cut and pasted
directly from tournament rules): bleed, hunt, equip, employ retainer, recruit ally,

political action, leave torpor, rescue a vampire from torpor, and diablerize a

vampire in torpor. Is "Condemnation" one of these? No. Case closed.

> The same way zahir can fetch in your library a contract / clandestine
> contract / dirty contract. Contract is a contract, condemnation is a
> condemnation. so NRA triggers.

Bzzzzzt! Sorrybadlogictryagain. Zahir can only fetch one contract with
his special "fetch contract" action. Were "Contract" and "Dirty Contract"
both actions, Zahir or any other Assamite could do them both. The fact
that Zahir can only fetch one of them per turn has nothing to do with whether
one can actually do a Condemnation: Doomed AND a Condemnation: Betrayed on
the same turn. They do not test the same way.

By the way, if Zahir could fetch a Condemenation with a special action
printed on his card, he could likewise fetch only one regardless of the
name of the card.

Fred

Messages.Author: Frederick Scott
Messages.Body:
Tommy Engvik wrote:
> I know I'm not LSJ, but my guess is that you can't play/attempt to

> Why? Because of this:
>
> Condemnation: Betrayed

>
> Condemnation: Doomed
> +1 stealth action. Condemnation.
>
> Condemnation: Languid
> +1 stealth action. Condemnation.
>
> All these actions are Condemnation actions,

Doesn't matter. Unless they're both the same type of card on the
list (bleed, hunt, equip, employ retainer, recruit ally, political action,

leave torpor, rescue a vampire from torpor, and diablerize a vampire in

torpor) or else have the same *name*, they do not qualify.

> because that's what
> they're described as. I'm guessing the "Condemnation." on the cards
> are there for two things:
> 1) To indentify which cards are Condemnation cards.

Correct. This is significant due to the card text on all of the
Condemnation cards which state that placing one Condemnation on a
minion removes all other Condemnations on a minion.

> 2) To show that the actions are of one type (Condemnation).

May be true. But I know of no rule in Jyhad which cares about that
at the current time. Maybe someone else does. But it's not the
NRA rule.

Fred

Messages.Body:
Frederick Scott wrote:
> Tommy Engvik wrote:
> > I know I'm not LSJ, but my guess is that you can't play/attempt to
> > play a condemnation, freak drive and then play another condemnation.
> > Why? Because of this:
> >
> > Condemnation: Betrayed
> > +1 stealth action. Condemnation.
> >
> > Condemnation: Doomed
> > +1 stealth action. Condemnation.
> >
> > Condemnation: Languid
> > +1 stealth action. Condemnation.
> >
> > All these actions are Condemnation actions,

Not true. One is a "Condemnation: Betrayed" action, another is a "Condemnation:
Doomed" action. The last is yet another action.

> Doesn't matter. Unless they're both the same type of card on the
> list (bleed, hunt, equip, employ retainer, recruit ally, political action,
> leave torpor, rescue a vampire from torpor, and diablerize a vampire in
> torpor) or else have the same *name*, they do not qualify.

Correct.

> > because that's what
> > they're described as. I'm guessing the "Condemnation." on the cards
> > are there for two things:
> > 1) To indentify which cards are Condemnation cards.
>
> Correct. This is significant due to the card text on all of the
> Condemnation cards which state that placing one Condemnation on a
> minion removes all other Condemnations on a minion.

Correct.

See also: the action to equip a gun is an equip action, not a gun action.

> > 2) To show that the actions are of one type (Condemnation).
>
> May be true. But I know of no rule in Jyhad which cares about that
> at the current time. Maybe someone else does. But it's not the
> NRA rule.

There's no such rule. Types of actions (which only matter to NRA)
are decribed in (and only in) the NRA rules - and those rules don't
support the "Condemnation type" argument.

--
